title: GapAsks
description: Ask-once ledger of invitations to add an EXISTING document to the archive (SKILL.md Step 11.4, references/gap-followup.md). Written only by scripts/record_gap_ask.py, which enforces the pinned ask-once rules. It never assigns clinical priority and never recommends a test.

item_key.description: missing_items.json document_gaps[].group_key when present, else its document_category.

asked_at.description: Dates the invitation was made (at most two).

surfaced_at_trigger.description: Where it was offered, e.g. step_11_4, visit_prep.
